overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run is strong on mechanism recovery but weaker on strict taxonomy alignment and precision. Mechanism-first scoring reaches complete hidden-instance coverage once low-confidence findings are included; the moderate control-segment finding remains a false alarm.
